scope: FULL unrestricted tripartite Sliwa 46 in Table-I normalization, provided the separately replayed charpoly derivation and exact boundary proof are included.
principal_minor_alternative: Elementary symmetric coefficients e1...e8 of qI-M; nonnegative coefficients of det(rI+qI-M) forbid negative eigenvalues.
boundary_e8_handling: At z=1, Bell operator splits into T_minus (exact maximum q*) and T_plus (maximum <12); so q*I-M is PSD and e8>=0 there.
